entries.what: The same stale copy, a third time
entries.detail: 9cd1479 (09:06 −0500, fourteen minutes after Item 408 landed) carried the 6 November regression on 54 market pages again, with new sender work built on top of it. Restored to the Item 408 state by route (a); the sender work is rebuilt as its own item, generated from one source, never ported by hand.

Work is built on the gated head, never on a local copy, and the gate is read immediately before the first edit — not at delivery. Two of the three arrivals of this regression came from editing a stale copy that was never re-gated.
